cohort: 3456 nulliparous women with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation who delivered at term
finding: The study found that the use of combined spinal-epidural analgesia (CSEA) during labor was associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery in Chinese nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Combined spinal-epidural analgesia (CSEA) use for pain management during labor was associated with a slightly increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery in Chinese nulliparous women.
